$schema_notes.purpose: Closed, machine-checkable rubric for a single critique→revise pass in the POP html pipeline. Run AFTER all screens in an app are generated (app-level, not per-batch of 2) so coherence violations are catchable. Feed each rule to the critic LLM as structured output; revise ONLY screens with violations, then stop (no re-critique of passing screens).
$schema_notes.critic_contract: Critic node input: the full app's screens (screen_id + body_html) + this rubric + the app theme. Critic output (structured): { violations: [ { screen_id, rule_id, severity, evidence, fix } ], app_violations: [ { rule_id, severity, evidence, fix, screen_ids } ] }. Reviser input: only screens whose ids appear in violations/app_violations, plus the specific {rule_id, fix} notes for each. Max one revise cycle.
$schema_notes.severity: blocker = must fix before ship (breaks the senior look or the design system). warn = fix if cheap; acceptable to ship. info = stylistic nudge, log only.
$schema_notes.scope: screen = evaluated on one screen in isolation. app = evaluated across all screens together.
$schema_notes.auto_hint: Rules with an `auto_check` string can be pre-filtered with a cheap deterministic/regex/DOM pass before spending LLM tokens — only send ambiguous cases to the critic.

rules.title: Exactly one dominant CTA per screen
rules.check: There is exactly one brand-filled (#ff5200 background) primary action of button size. Zero is allowed on pure-browse feeds where the cards are the action; two or more is a violation.
rules.fix: Keep the single most important action brand-filled + glowing; demote the rest to ghost/flat (transparent bg, 1px #333 border) or an icon button.
rules.auto_check: count elements with background #ff5200 AND padding >=14px AND (border-radius 16px) AND font-weight >=800; >1 → flag

rules.title: One glow per zone — glow is rare
rules.check: Brand glow box-shadows (rgba(255,82,0,...) with blur) appear on at most one element per visual zone (hero, content, action). Multiple glowing cards/chips/buttons stacked in one zone is the #1 amateur tell.
rules.fix: Remove glow from all but the single highest-emphasis element in each zone. Non-focal cards get a hairline border, not a shadow.
rules.auto_check: count box-shadows containing 'rgba(255,82,0'; if >3 total on one screen, send to critic to judge per-zone

rules.title: Never a light/white page background
rules.check: The screen/body background is a canonical dark surface (#0d0d0d). No white/near-white page or large light panels.
rules.fix: Set page bg to #0d0d0d; cards to #1f1f1f; raised to #262626.
rules.auto_check: body/root background not in {#0d0d0d,#0d0d0d} → flag; scan for #fff/#ffffff/#f... as a large-area background

rules.title: Only canonical token colors
rules.check: Every color traces to the canonical palette or an effect recipe. No eyeballed/off-palette hex (e.g. #ff6b3d instead of #ff5200, random greys outside the tonal ladder).
rules.fix: Snap each stray color to the nearest canonical token value.
rules.auto_check: extract all hex; whitelist = canonical palette + effect rgba tints + placeholder greys (#242424,#1b1b1b,#2a2a2a,#1e1e1e,#1a1a1a,#6f6f6f,#cfcfcf); anything else → flag

rules.title: Semantic colors keep their meaning
rules.check: Green (#0db651) only for money saved/earned/positive; yellow (#fbbc09) only for rewards/POPcoins; red (#ee4d37) only for destructive/failed; brand orange only for primary action/active state. No swaps (e.g. green CTA, red price).
rules.fix: Recolor to the correct semantic token.

rules.title: Repeated items use ONE row/card pattern
rules.check: A list/feed of repeated items uses a single consistent row or card pattern with the same right-side variant. No ad-hoc individually-styled blocks ('atom soup'); no mixed row variants (some chevron, some button) in one list.
rules.fix: Rebuild the list from one recipe (payment-list-row or transaction-list-row or card), same variant throughout, hairline dividers inside one card.

rules.title: The P1 is actually dominant
rules.check: The single most important element leads and is dominant by size/weight/tone — not merely present. The focal amount/hero is the largest type; the primary action is the brightest element.
rules.fix: Increase size/weight/tone of the P1; demote competing elements. If two things compete, one is wrong.

rules.title: Composed from named patterns, not raw atoms
rules.check: Zones are built from recognizable POP patterns (card, list row, bento, hero, section-header) — not loose stacked divs/labels/buttons with no card or list container.
rules.fix: Wrap loose content in the correct recipe surface; add a section-header above each group.

rules.title: Every content group has a section header
rules.check: Each distinct content group is introduced by a section header (bold title, optional See-all).
rules.fix: Add a section-header recipe above each group.

rules.title: Type comes from the scale; hierarchy is visible
rules.check: Text sizes/weights map to the type scale (no arbitrary sizes); there is clear hierarchy (titles ExtraBold/Bold, body Medium). Not a flat wall of same-size same-weight text.
rules.fix: Map each text element to its element→style; vary weight/size with intent.
rules.auto_check: collect font-size values; if >1 element uses a size not in {36,32,24,20,18,16,14,12} (+ the sanctioned focal 44-52), flag

rules.title: Serif only for editorial moments
rules.check: Instrument Serif appears only on a hero tagline/promo line, if at all — never on body, labels, helpers, numbers, or state text.
rules.fix: Switch functional serif text to Figtree.
rules.auto_check: regex for Instrument Serif / serif font-family on elements that are labels/body/amounts → flag

rules.title: No text below 12px; body ≥ 14px
rules.check: No functional text under 12px; body/meta at least 14px (12px only for captions/overlines).
rules.fix: Raise undersized text to the nearest scale step.

rules.title: 20px margins, 24px section gaps, 8px rhythm
rules.check: Screen side margins ~20px; between-section gaps ~24px; spacing values on the 4/8 rhythm; no arbitrary paddings.
rules.fix: Snap paddings/margins/gaps to the spacing scale.
rules.auto_check: collect padding/margin/gap px; flag values not in {4,8,12,14,16,20,22,24,26,40,64} (14/22/26 sanctioned for card internals/thumb zones)

rules.title: Radii from the scale
rules.check: border-radius values come from the rounded scale (8/12/16/20/24/32/9999) — no eyeballed radii.
rules.fix: Snap to nearest scale radius.
rules.auto_check: collect border-radius px; flag values not in {8,11,12,13,15,16,18,20,22,24,26,32,9999} (11/13/15 sanctioned inner-thumb radii)

rules.title: POPcoin/offers appear wherever money does
rules.check: On screens showing prices/amounts/payment, the reward (POPcoin pill or offer) is present — POP's signature. Money without a reward hook is a miss.
rules.fix: Add an amount-with-popcoin pill or offer-highlight near the money.

rules.title: Branded placeholders, no blank grey boxes or hand-drawn SVG
rules.check: Image areas use the branded placeholder recipe (brand-tinted radial + diagonal stripe + monospace caption), not a flat grey rectangle and not a hand-drawn illustrative SVG.
rules.fix: Replace with the placeholder recipe; vary radial hue per card.
rules.auto_check: flag image-area divs whose background is a single solid grey with no gradient/repeating-linear-gradient; flag inline <svg> with >4 path/shape nodes used as illustration

rules.title: Real, plausible content — no lorem/placeholder labels
rules.check: No 'lorem ipsum', 'Item 1', 'Title', 'Lorem', 'xxxx', or numeric placeholders. Content is specific and plausible for the concept.
rules.fix: Replace with realistic domain content.

rules.title: Tappable icons have 44px targets
rules.check: Icon buttons / tappable controls have ~44px touch targets (a 24px glyph in a 40–44px hit area).
rules.fix: Wrap small glyphs in a 40–44px container.

rules.title: Brand/bank/UPI logos never recolored
rules.check: Any brand, bank, or UPI logo keeps its official colors; not tinted to the palette.
rules.fix: Restore original logo colors.

rules.title: Bottom nav only on top-level; omitted on sub-flows/results/modals
rules.check: Bottom nav present on top-level destinations; absent on detail sub-pages, forms, results, and overlays. Active tab uses filled icon + brand.
rules.fix: Add/remove bottom-nav per archetype; fix the active tab styling.
rules.auto_check: archetype in {detail,form,result,overlay} AND bottom-nav present → flag

rules.title: Balances don't default to visible
rules.check: Sensitive balances render masked (••••) with a reveal toggle by default.
rules.fix: Mask the balance; add a visibility toggle.

rules.title: Frozen chrome is identical across screens
rules.check: Top bar and bottom nav are structurally identical across all screens (same heights, paddings, icon set, ordering) — only the active tab and location/title text differ. Divergent chrome between screens breaks app cohesion.
rules.fix: Replace divergent chrome with the frozen top-bar / bottom-nav constants.
rules.auto_check: diff the top-bar and bottom-nav subtrees across screens; structural mismatch → flag the outliers

rules.title: Same component looks the same everywhere
rules.check: A given pattern (card, list row, hero) uses consistent radius/padding/tone across all screens. No screen-to-screen drift in the same component.
rules.fix: Normalize the drifting instances to the recipe values.

rules.title: Color budget holds across the app
rules.check: Across the app the 70/20/10 dominance holds — orange stays rare. No screen floods with brand color; the app reads as calm-dark with orange accents.
rules.fix: Reduce orange area on offending screens to accents only.
